scientific_integrity: A self-contained truncation lemma and the published general weak-compactness criterion yield the proof; no computer experiment is used as a proof and no independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite measure, proper generalized N-function and uniform Delta2 are essential stated assumptions; no assertion on sigma-finite infinite-measure spaces.
Some historical adjacent papers were accessible only in abstract/metadata; full bibliographic priority remains subject to independent comparison.
title: An Andô modular weak-compactness criterion without spatial uniformity on finite measures
